**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2022/03/09 (Wed) 17:36
- [FACT] The user got a nasty sunburn on their shoulders when they went to the beach with their family back in August.
- [PREFERENCE] The user is looking for skincare recommendations for soothing and moisturizing sun-damaged skin.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Aloe vera gel is recommended as a natural soothing agent to reduce inflammation, redness, and pain; apply directly to the affected area 2-3 times a day.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Cool compresses should be applied to the affected area for 15-20 minutes, 2-3 times a day to reduce heat and itching.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Over-the-counter hydrocortisone cream (1%) can help reduce inflammation and itching.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Topical creams or gels containing lidocaine or benzocaine can numb the area and reduce pain.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The user should moisturize with a gentle, non-comedogenic moisturizer rich in emollients and humectants, looking for ingredients like hyaluronic acid, ceramides, or niacinamide.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] After-sun lotions containing soothing ingredients like aloe vera, green tea, or chamomile are recommended.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Gently exfoliate with a chemical exfoliant once the initial sunburn has subsided to promote cell turnover.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended products include:
  - Neutrogena After Sun Lotion: gentle, non-greasy lotion for long-lasting moisturization.
  - La Roche-Posay Anthelios Melt-In Sunscreen Milk: lightweight, non-comedogenic sunscreen that can be used as a moisturizer.
  - CeraVe Moisturizing Cream: rich, non-comedogenic moisturizer for dry, sun-damaged skin.
  - Dermalogica Daily Moisturizing Cream: hydrating cream that helps repair and protect the skin.
  - EltaMD UV Clear Broad-Spectrum SPF 46: gentle, non-comedogenic sunscreen for daily use.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The user should stay hydrated by drinking plenty of water to help skin regenerate and recover from sun damage.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The user should avoid further sun exposure until their skin has fully recovered and wear protective clothing when outside.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The user should be patient as sun damage can take time to heal.
- [PREFERENCE] The user is looking for face moisturizers that can provide extra protection against cold weather.
